name: Soul Machine
storyline:
Letum was once a paradise until the star Potens miraculously turned into a black hole and something ancient heard its call.
They came not to destroy, but to convert cities into towering monoliths, people into the aliens' own entertainment and the sky into a prison.
Now deep, buried within the aliens' monoliths, one survivor rose. Armed with scrap and objects carved from gravity itself. only you can undo the horrific changes they have made.
Fight like a machine with soul and purpose.
summary: First Person Rogue-like with an incentive of choice. Set on a planet where a silent war between an alien race and a human soldier rage on. Craft your own build with self made weapons and personalized upgrades. Erratic enemies keep you on your toes so Fight like a machine with soul and purpose.
